# Feature Session Template

Use this at the start of any feature development session. Copy it, fill it in, and use it as your session brief.

---

## Session Brief

**Feature:** `docs/features/XX-feature-name/README.md`  
**Session Goal:** _What do you want to walk away with? (Design doc? Working code? Decision on approach?)_  
**Phase:** _1 / 2 / 3_  

---

## Pre-Session Checklist

Before starting design or building, read:

- [ ] `docs/VISION.md` — is this feature aligned with the product vision?
- [ ] `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — does this fit the system architecture?
- [ ] `docs/features/XX-feature-name/README.md` — review vision, open questions, dependencies
- [ ] Dependency features — are they done? Any decisions from them that affect this feature?
- [ ] `docs/research/forks-and-oss.md` — confirm which OSS tools this feature uses
